Context

We grew while the economy around us stalled

Under Colombia’s first left-wing national government (2022–2026), the economy slowed sharply. GDP grew just +0.6% in 2023, the weakest in over two decades, and the sectors our customers operate in went flat or down.

Trucking / Road transport
+1%
The fleets we equip: tonnage barely moved
Construction
−4.2%
Building activity fell
Industry
−3.5%
Manufacturing output fell
Whiting Door Colombia
+24%
Total sales since 2024
Insight

The fleet and industrial sectors we serve were flat or shrinking, yet we grew double digits and lifted orders to HQ +50%. That is share gain in a down market: proof of a resilient, well-run business, not a passing tailwind.

Sources: DANE (GDP and sectors) and Ministerio de Transporte / RNDC (road freight tonnage), 2023.

Expansion

Deepen our Colombian zones and grow abroad, more fleets across Colombia, Ecuador, Panama, Peru and the Dominican Republic.

Lead with premium doors and the full Whiting door range, win large fleet accounts, and keep improving the mix.
